artifact_type: Demeter manual factual extraction; not publisher JSON
population: U.S. Look AHEAD adults recruited at ages 45-76 with overweight/obesity and established type 2 diabetes; includes baseline insulin users
intervention: Intensive lifestyle program including diet, physical activity and weight loss; not an isolated UPF intervention
outcome: Partial or complete diabetes remission at the annual visit, without antihyperglycemic medication
uncertainty: Published 95% confidence intervals; visits are repeated measures, covariance unavailable
notes: Retain the Figure 2 caption's year-four lifestyle upper limit of 9.4 as printed. The abstract/main text's multiple-imputation analysis gives 8.4; these records do not silently combine the two analyses.
Counts reconcile to the reported rounded percentages. Attrition and repeated-measure covariance preclude treating annual differences as independent causal estimates.
No dose, lag, age modifier or remission hazard is inferred from these observations.
